get.summary: Read the budget of one owning system
get.description: Research and media own separate budgets. Apply this operation only to the selected authority; there is no cross-system transaction. Return confirmed state or a structured error; reconcile ambiguous writes before retrying.

post.summary: Request a magazine draft for a local date
post.description: Create a draft through Research using the configured source registry and topics. Deduplicate scheduled and manual draft requests by local date and configuration revision. This does not release text or create audio.
